current.text: He competes with Yaxel Lendeborg for the same starting forward minutes. Recent preseason projections start Lendeborg and have Santos coming off the bench.
Kerr often changes his announced starting lineup a few games in. The starting wing and guard spots among Podziemski, Melton, Lendeborg and Santos are not settled.
He might still start, and rest days for Golden State veterans should give him enough minutes either way. Josh still prefers Podziemski and Lendeborg.
The more Draymond Green plays center, the more minutes open up for Santos and Lendeborg.
Jimmy Butler is out for at least half the season. His return could reshuffle the wing rotation and cut into Santos's role.
After last season's trade deadline he played 31 minutes a game, averaged 15 points, 6 rebounds, 4 assists and 1.5 steals, and ranked 72nd. Before the deadline he ranked 302nd.
Draft him in rounds 11 to 13 as a late flyer. He could be top 70 after the trade deadline, and a usage rate above 20 is possible with Porzingis out.
Draft him late together with Lendeborg as a hedge, and keep whichever one wins the role.
Some of his shooting last season was fluky.
Golden State may treat this season as a gap year. The team is worried about lottery odds and may rest veterans, which opens minutes for younger players.
Golden State's depth is very poor. The team struggles to field a 10-man rotation, so minutes should go up across the rotation.
Golden State has 15 back-to-backs, tied for second most. Its schedule is good for fantasy playoffs that end March 28.

durable.text: He can create his own shot and has size. Outside of Steph Curry, almost nobody else on Golden State can do that.
He scored big when Curry was out last season and did much less when he played alongside Curry.

note: Yahoo and ESPN both value him at 0 USD (ranks 149 and 249), and experts put him in rounds 11 to 13. That is near the end of our 144-player pool, so he is a 1 USD bench flyer at most, ideally paired with Lendeborg as a role hedge. His projected line has no strong category and no punt flag, so his value comes from minutes, like the 31-minute, rank-72 stretch after last year's deadline. Early on, check whether he starts over Lendeborg, how often Draymond plays center and how his minutes hold up before Butler returns.
